turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I've got until 4:40, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Then don't waste it, Hale. You haven't answered me. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, and who made the call?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Don't manage me. I asked you a question twice and I'm still waiting on an answer, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side, Hale. Owen has a zero and I don't know why. What do you have?
